<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/update_project_variables/{guid}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces a project's stored variables with the provided list, then
schedules a git commit and propagation of the change to other users'
clones.

Node config values reference variables by label, so a save that would
leave a reference dangling (the variable deleted or renamed) or a secret
in a non-password field is refused with the usages it would break, unless
`force` - the editor asks the user first. Those nodes would otherwise fail
on their next start.
